episodes.title: A Father's Great Expectations
episodes.summary: The Kennedys rally to put Jack in the White House but their difficult past illuminates a deeper struggle.

episodes.title: Shared Victories, Private Struggles
episodes.summary: The Presidential election comes down to the wire; Bobby tells Joe Sr. he's leaving politics.

episodes.title: Failed Invasion, Failed Fidelity
episodes.summary: When the Bay of Pigs invasion proves disastrous, JFK makes a difficult decision he must later atone for.

episodes.title: Broken Promises and Deadly Barriers
episodes.summary: The Russians build a wall separating East and West Berlin while Bobby prepares to go after Sam Giancana.

episodes.title: Moral Issues and Inner Turmoil
episodes.summary: Riots over desegregation in the South force JFK to act. Jackie's use of amphetamines continues. Joe Sr. suffers a stroke.

episodes.title: On the Brink of War
episodes.summary: The Cuban Missile Crisis brings America and Russia to the brink of war. Jackie leaves JFK after one infidelity too many.

episodes.title: The Countdown to Tragedy
episodes.summary: Jack and Jackie suffer the loss of their newborn child; she and JFK are in Dallas on that fateful day in November.

episodes.title: The Aftermath: A Family's Curse of Misfortune and Heartbreak
episodes.summary: Bobby blames himself for his brother's death. Five years later, tragedy strikes again.
